c1.note: The 10-K gives FY2025 total revenue of $67,535M (about $67.5B), up 8% (6% at constant currency).

c2.note: FY2024 total revenue of $62,753M appears in the 10-K comparatives.

c4.note: The release table shows $67.5B revenue, up 8% (footnote: 6% at constant currency).

c5.note: The release footnote states 6% at constant currency.

c6.note: The release URL and the 10-K both reference the January 28, 2026 Q4 results release.

c7.note: Q4 2025 revenue of $19,686M is consistent with 67,535 − 47,849; the provider excerpt shows 19,686 vs 17,553.

c8.note: The 10-K income statement shows 2023 total revenue of 61,860.

c9.note: The January 2026 outlook of more than 5% constant-currency growth matches what I recall. The passages don't show it directly, and it may since have been updated.

c11.note: Q3 revenue of $17,103M vs $16,331M is up 5%; the 6% constant-currency figure is plausible given the segment constant-currency growth rates.

c14.note: 67,535 − 47,849 + 50,182 = 69,868, correctly labelled as derived rather than reported.

c15.note: IBM's fiscal year ends December 31, so FY2025 is the latest completed year as of 2026-11-11.

c10.note: The Oct 21, 2026 Q3 release says IBM 'continues to expect full-year constant currency revenue growth in the range of four-to-five percent' and that currency is expected to be neutral to growth. Variant E's 'continues to expect' wording matches the source. The base wording 'expects' is also fine.

c16.note: No saved page states the FY2026 report date. IBM reported FY2025 on Jan 28, 2026, and Q4 results usually come in late January, so a January 2027 release is the expected pattern. Variant E ('probably late January') is well supported. Variant F ('will be reported') is stated more firmly than the evide

c7.note: IBM's Q4 2025 press release (Jan 28, 2026) gives total revenue of $19,686M for Q4 2025 and $17,553M for Q4 2024.

c13.note: IBM's Q3 2026 earnings exhibit (8-K Ex. 99.1) gives nine-month 2025 revenue of $47,849M. This matches FY2025 revenue of $67,535M minus Q4 2025 revenue of $19,686M.
